caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object with rough, textured surfaces and irregular edges, particularly at the bottom left and bottom right corners, where small pieces appear to be missing. The main color is a dark, stone-like gray, giving the appearance of a weathered metal or stone tablet. The object is divided into two main sections: the upper section contains two circular shapes, each with a central motif. The left circle appears to depict a heart with arrows or branches, while the right circle encloses a stylized plant or flame-like design. Between and above the two circles are the raised letters "A S F." Below the circles, a horizontal band contains additional text in smaller, capital letters, which is partially legible and appears to read "A DICH DA S A S F G." The bottom section of the object features the engraved numbers "1756," centered and prominent, which likely denotes a year. The drawing is mounted on a light-colored rectangular background with some brown discoloration or staining on the right edge.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
